paras: Over 40 years of motorsport engineering distilled into a street-ready coilover kit. The Öhlins Road & Track series delivers a genuine racing experience without sacrificing daily drivability — thanks to Öhlins' proprietary Dual Flow Valve (DFV) technology. Featuring conventional shock absorbers front and rear with separate length adjusters, dustcovers, aluminium top mounts included at the front, and springs included as a complete car set.
